hooks.command: test -f AGENTS.md && jq -n --rawfile c AGENTS.md '{additionalContext: ("Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:\n\n" + $c)}' || true

if (Test-Path AGENTS.md) { @{ additionalContext = "Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:`n`n" + (Get-Content -Raw AGENTS.md) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

context=$(for f in docs/data-team-context.md docs/project-context.md .cortex/notes/project-context.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '

## %s
' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done); if [ -n "$context" ]; then jq -n --arg c "$context" '{additionalContext: ("Durable project context loaded from the context ledger and local notes. Treat it as planning context; verify before high-risk action.
" + $c)}'; fi || true

$files = @('docs/data-team-context.md', 'docs/project-context.md', '.cortex/notes/project-context.md'); $parts = @(); foreach ($p in $files) { if (Test-Path $p) { $parts += "`n`n## $p`n" + (Get-Content -Raw $p) } }; if ($parts.Count -gt 0) { @{ additionalContext = "Durable project context loaded from the context ledger and local notes. Treat it as planning context; verify before high-risk action.`n" + ($parts -join "") } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) && files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null) && { test -n "$files" && mkdir -p .cortex/notes && { printf '
## %s — %s
' "$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M)" "$branch"; printf '%s
' "$files" | sed 's/^/- /'; } >> ".cortex/notes/session-log.md"; } || true

$b = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); $f = (git diff --name-only 2>$null); if ($f) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .cortex/notes | Out-Null; "`n## $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH:mm') — $b" | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md; ($f | ForEach-Object { "- $_" }) | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md }
